summary: Company introduction: heading, one or two paragraphs (with **bold** key terms), optional ticks and a button on the left; on the right a 4 x 3 checkerboard of flat brand-tinted tiles and photo tiles (after Contra Labs on Mobbin). The tiles turn in as a diagonal wave when the grid is seen; then every few seconds one photo trades places with a tinted tile next to it by turning over, until the visitor scrolls away or presses Pause animations. Needs 6-9 real photos of the client's offices, desks and city; extra photos rotate in.
